mapper.insert: insert into cart_item ( user_id, goods_id, quantity, is_selected ) values ( #{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{quantity}, #{selected} )
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, goods_id as goodsId, quantity, is_selected as selected, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from cart_item where user_id = #{userId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}

select c.id as cartId, c.goods_id as goodsId, c.quantity, c.is_selected as selected,
g.name as goodsName, g.price, g.photo_url as photoUrl, g.inventory, g.status, g.deleted from cart_item c left join goods g on c.goods_id = g.id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.update_time desc
